current.text: He is projected to start at shooting guard, in the same starting five as last season: Cunningham, Robinson, Thompson, Collins and Duren.

He is a streaming option for threes, not a draft target.

Detroit is projected to win 50 to 51 games and finish as the third or fourth seed in the East.
